# requires: wanted
#
# A folder is the door for a person with no program. A text file put in
# wanted/ is a request: a URL, optionally a digest, optionally a destination
# inside the store. The folder answers by renaming the file, and the name is
# the whole of what a person has to read.
#
# It is a wider door than a record, because anyone who can write to the share
# can use it, so it accepts less: only http and https, only destinations inside
# the store that are not the store's own, and never a header or a credential.
# B through F are refused and their text is kept; A and G are taken, and the
# folder says how each ended.
drop A src=http:plain size=64 digest=good
drop B src=http:plain size=64 dest=../outside.bin
drop C src=http:plain size=64 dest=jobs/x.json
drop D src=http:plain size=64 dest=wanted/again.txt
drop E src=file size=64
drop F text=not-a-url
drop G src=http:status-404 size=64 digest=bad dest=models/
sweep
run A alpha
run G gamma
sweep

# expect 8: A=accepted [DL-W1]
# expect 8: G=accepted
# expect 8: B=refused [DL-W2]
# expect 8: C=refused
# expect 8: D=refused
# expect 8: E=refused [DL-W3]
# expect 8: F=refused
# expect 9: ok state=transferred
# expect 9: done=64 err=none
# expect 10: transfer-failed state=failed
# expect 11: A=done [DL-W4]
# expect 11: G=failed
